quizGuardRationale: Direct symmetric nontransitive exclusions protect actual ordinary meanings or underqualified English labels, not unrestricted substitutability. Baseline exclusions are unchanged.
ごくろうさま and ごちそうさま protect generic thanks/gratitude labels on ありがとう/どうも/御礼/感謝/礼. Their effort-versus-meal scopes do not alone justify a mutual pair or a before-versus-after meal pair with いただきます.
焦げる protects positive burn/scorch meanings, including transitive 焦がす/焼く and intransitive 焼ける/燃える. A transitivity distinction alone does not make burn answer labels unique.
凍える protects 凍る freeze and 冷える chilly wording. Ambient/weather 寒い and touch-cold 冷たい are not automatically bodily-numbness synonyms.

心当たり protects 見当 idea/estimate and source knowing wording through 知る/ご存じ/知識. Supplemental idea/notion labels on アイデア/アイディア/考え/観念 and actual think-of/recall 思い付く are independently checked for broad English-label ambiguity; not an assertion that a new design and a remembered lead are unrestricted Japanese synonyms.

心得る protects knowing/understanding/awareness on 知る/分かる/理解/承知/ご存じ/知識/意識 and supplemental 納得/承る, with actual acceptance on 応ずる and knowing-of on 心当たり directly assessed. Memorization alone does not create a guard to 覚える.
腰掛け protects positive seat/chair/bench/place-to-sit labels on いす/ベンチ/席/座席; no sofa/auditorium clique inferred. 腰掛ける separately protects ordinary 座る and seating invitation おかけください.
五十音 protects existing generic syllabary labels on 仮名/片仮名 without collapsing chart arrangement and script identity. Every letter/character is not automatically the syllabary.
こしらえる protects directly evidenced making/manufacturing/building/preparing senses through 作る/製造/生産/建てる/準備/用意/支度. A factory restriction is not inferred from manufacture.

擦る protects ごしごし's scrubbing, 磨く's actual rubbing/polishing sense and 削る's scrape-off sense. Rubbing need not remove material or produce a polished result; other readings of 削る not transferred to けずる.
個体/個人 protects the unqualified individual answer, not an assertion that every specimen is a person. 固体 is a distinct homophone with nonoverlapping solid-matter label.
小遣い protects generic money labels on お金/金/金銭 and actual allowance wording on 支給. Costs 費用 and spending 支出 are not automatically spending funds.
古典/クラシック has positive classic-work overlap beyond the latter's musical sense. Homophones and unrelated English cock meanings do not generate exclusions.
sourceAccessLimits: Seventeen new articles and three reused articles cover N2:542-N2:561. Community membership, not an official modern JLPT syllabus; practical selections are not independent levels for every secondary sense.
Four new primary reciprocal N2 pairs: 凍/凍える, 腰/腰掛け, 腰/腰掛ける, 個/個体. Separate 超/越す alias-reading pair uses visible 超す/こす label; not a fifth primary pair.
Primary written 焦, 擦, 胡, 椒, 遣 and 典 remain metadata despite missing component cards. No new kanji/stroke article fabricated. Optional 御/走 links on kana-primary ごちそう do not alter its empty array.
Raw mixed source glosses preserved. 擦る separates こする from する; コック separates cook from valve. ごちそうさま feast mismatch is documented rather than made into a noun sense.
こちらこそ public lookup failed to yield a lexical body and is not counted as positive verification. Complete JMdict principal evidence remains available; no search-summary substitution.
Baseline identity, title, reading, arrays, existing exclusions and easier levels preserved. Only こっそり gains a sourced jlpt2; its existing image/scene metadata and bytes are preserved.
Author public-entry receipts are not independent reviewer retrieval. Full copyrighted lexical bodies remain private; public observations are concise original paraphrases and URLs/hashes.

No executed app quiz draws, corpus frequency measurement, native-speaker certification or exhaustive baseline-card rereview. Initial derivative removes only quizGuardRationale; mappings/source notes remain author assertions to assess.
